blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas advanced to the ninth-place battle after sweeping Mongolia, 25-13, 25-11, 25-20, in the Asian Games women’s volleyball classification round on Monday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium. Angel Canino, coming off a rest, returned to action and led Alas’ offense anew with 14 points and nine digs as the Filipinos cruised to their second straight win in the classification. The Philippines goes for a ninth-place finish in the Asian Games against Hong Kong on Tuesday. Canino sat out in the team’s first win on […]...
